Khi ghi sổ phiếu chi (kể cả ghi lùi ngày: When posting a payment (even backdated) or cancelling a receipt, the software checks that the balance stays non-negative at every later point in time.

Mẫu sổ và phiếu in ra luôn bằng tiếng Vi: Printed books and vouchers are always in Vietnamese, following the Ministry of Finance layouts.

The enterprise is responsible for the accuracy of its figures and for complying with current accounting and tax regulations. If accounting software is used to keep the books, check the rules on accounting software and the applicable regime (Circular 133, Circular 99/2025, Circular 58/2026) with your accountant or the tax authority.
